items.title: StarFive Dubhe-100 – A 64-bit, RVA23-compliant RISC-V core for high-performance applications
items.summary: StarFive has launched a new high-performance 64-bit RISC-V core from the Dubhe family with the RVA23-compliant Dubhe-100 designed for servers and HPC, as well as other high-performance applications. The new RISC-V IP core delivers a SPECint2006 score of 15/GHz, supports Vector and Vector Crypto extensions, and features a deep out-of-order design with a 15-stage pipeline and 6-wide issue. StarFive Dubhe-100 key features and specifications: ISA – RV64GCBVH 15-stage pipeline, 6-issue Superscalar, deep out-of-order execution Support Multi-core cache coherence Support instruction fusion Support AIA1.0 Performance SPECint2006: 15/GHz Dhrystone v2.2: 10.0/MHz (legal) HPM (Hardware Performance Monitor) RISC-V standard HPM support Micro-architecture level analysis and performance tuning PMP & PMA (Physical Memory Protection / Physical Memory Attributes) Configurable 16/32/64 PMP supported regions, minimum 4096-byte region size Support predefined PMA and Svpbmt Debug & Trace Standard debug module compliant with RISC-V Debug Spec Standard Trace module interface compliant with RISC-V Trace Spec Power Management [...] The post StarFive Dubhe-100 – A 64-bit, RVA23-compliant RISC-V core for high-performance applications appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .
items.title_zh: StarFive 发布 Dubhe-100 高性能 64 位 RISC-V 内核
items.summary_zh: StarFive 推出符合 RVA23 规范的 64 位 RISC-V 内核 Dubhe-100，面向服务器与 HPC 等高性能应用。该内核采用 15 级流水线、6 发射超标量深度乱序架构，支持 Vector 与 Vector Crypto 扩展，SPECint2006 得分达 15/GHz，并具备多核缓存一致性与 AIA1.0 中断支持。
items.why_it_matters_zh: Dubhe-100 以 RVA23 合规与 15/GHz 的 SPECint2006 性能，展示了 RISC-V 在高性能计算领域的竞争力。

items.title: Espressif Systems releases a Linux BSP developer preview for ESP32-S31 RISC-V microprocessor
items.summary: The ESP32-S31 microprocessor is getting Linux support from Espressif Systems. The ESP32-S31 dual-core RISC-V microprocessor was first unveiled in March, two ESP32-S31 development boards followed in May, and mass production was announced a few weeks ago. The new RISC-V chip features an MMU (Memory Management Unit), which makes Linux much easier to handle, and the development boards also come with 16MB PSRAM, so a minimal Linux image is possible. Moving from theory to practice, Espressif Systems has now released a developer preview version of the ESP Linux BSP for ESP32-S31, and some community Linux ports are also in the works (more on that at the end of the article). Let’s focus on the official ESP Linux BSP. The aforementioned repo only contains the image layout and packaging tools used by the ESP32-S31 Buildroot integration, and the core of the project can be found in the esp-buildroot-external repo with ESP32-S31 NOR boot [...] The post Espressif Systems releases a Linux BSP developer preview for ESP32-S31 RISC-V microprocessor appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .

There are a number of fairly late reverts – the drm scheduling reverts stand out, but there’s a few other ones in here too. It may not be pretty, but it’s the correct way to deal with “oh, that code wasn’t ready and caused problems”. People will be trying that again later. But while the drm reverts stand out and are some of the bigger patches in here, there’s a lot of small fixes all over. Mostly in drivers, but networking remained fairly active this last week too. items.title: KAGA FEI ES4L15MA1 is a ridiculously small, ready-to-use BLE 6.0 module based on Nordic nRF54L15 SoC
items.summary: Japanese company KAGA FEI has introduced another incredibly small ES4L15MA1 Bluetooth LE 6.0 module based on Nordic Semiconductor’s nRF54L15 ultra-low-power Cortex-M33 wireless MCU. Launched alongside the larger EC4L15MA1 module, the ES4L15MA1 module appears to be based on the same hardware as the ES4L15BA1 “world’s smallest module” unveiled in 2024 with an 8.55 x 3.25 x 1.00 mm form factor. The main difference is that the new modules come with ready-to-use embedded software providing a command-based API via UART to shorten product development cycles and lower development costs for IoT devices relying on Bluetooth LE 6.0 connectivity. items.title: Pine64 hits pause on Linux devices due to RAM and eMMC shortage/high prices
items.summary: While some companies keep increasing prices, the Pine64 community has now announced they don’t intend to manufacture Linux devices due to the current RAM and eMMC flash shortage and related high prices. Pine64 started with the launch of the Pine A64 development board in 2015, and since then they have launched more Arm and RISC-V Linux SBCs, Linux smartphones, and Linux tablets and e-Readers. We used to get several announcements per year, but this year so far, we only covered one: the Pine64 PineVoice. But it’s not a Linux device, and instead, a smart speaker based on a BL602 RISC-V microcontroller. Here’s the full (unedited) announcement published on Telegram, which you should also find on other Pine64 channels: Hi everyone! Just a quick reminder that due to the current DRAM/eMMC shortage, there isn’t any plans to continue producing more Linux devices in the near future. Whether production continues or not [...] The post Pine64 hits pause on Linux devices due to RAM and eMMC shortage/high prices appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .

items.title: Linux 7.0-mk2 Released For Multi-Kernel Linux With Promising Performance Results
items.summary: Last year a multi-kernel architecture was proposed for the Linux kernel to allow multiple independent kernel instances to co-exist on a single physical machine. Each kernel with "multikernel" Linux can run on dedicated CPU cores whole sharing the underlying hardware resources. Linux 7.0-mk2 released today with the kernel patched for this multi-kernel behavior...
items.title_zh: Linux 7.0-mk2 发布，多内核架构带来性能提升
items.summary_zh: 去年，Linux 内核提出了多内核架构，允许在单台物理机上共存多个独立内核实例。每个 multikernel 内核可运行在专用 CPU 核心上，同时共享底层硬件资源。Linux 7.0-mk2 今日发布，内核已针对该多内核行为完成补丁。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 多内核架构让多个内核共享硬件资源，有望显著提升性能与资源利用率，后续发展值得关注。

items.title: LLVM/Clang 23.1 Released With AMD Zen 6 & NVIDIA Rigel Support, Partial C++26 Support
items.summary: LLVM 23.1 was released today on-schedule as the first stable release of the LLVM 23 series as the H2'2026 update to this open-source compiler stack...
items.title_zh: LLVM/Clang 23.1 发布，新增 AMD Zen 6 与 NVIDIA Rigel 支持
items.summary_zh: LLVM 23.1 今日按计划发布，作为 LLVM 23 系列的第一个稳定版本，是该开源编译器栈的 2026 下半年更新。新版本加入对 AMD Zen 6 与 NVIDIA Rigel 的支持，并带来部分 C++26 支持。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 提前支持 AMD Zen 6 和 NVIDIA Rigel 等新硬件平台，同时推进 C++26 标准落地，对编译器生态意义重大。

items.title: New AF_ALG Restrictions With Linux 7.3 Due To The Security & Maintenance Nightmare
items.summary: The past few Linux kernel cycles have chipped away at AF_ALG functionality for that interface for user-space programs to access the kernel's internal cryptography API. Linux has been dropping AF_ALG features like zero-copy support and offloading. AF_ALG was quickly deprecated in Linux 7.2 while now for Linux 7.3 it's being further restricted...
items.title_zh: Linux 7.3进一步收紧AF_ALG加密接口功能
items.summary_zh: 出于安全与维护负担考虑，Linux内核近年来持续削减AF_ALG功能，包括移除零拷贝支持和卸载能力。AF_ALG在7.2中已被弃用，7.3将继续施加更严格的限制。
items.why_it_matters_zh: AF_ALG限制收紧影响用户空间程序调用内核加密API，可能促使相关项目转向替代方案。

items.title: Linux 7.3 Improving RAID 5/6 Benchmark-Based Algorithm Selection
items.summary: Following the main set of memory management "MM" changes submitted for Linux 7.3, Andrew Morton sent in his "non-MM" pull request of the other patches he's been collecting from various developers for this next Linux kernel release. Standing out there were some improvements to the RAID 5/6 benchmark-based algorithm selection...
items.title_zh: Linux 7.3改进RAID 5/6基于基准测试的算法选择
items.summary_zh: 在Linux 7.3合并窗口中，Andrew Morton提交了非MM补丁集，其中包含对RAID 5/6基于基准测试算法选择的优化改进，有助于提升存储子系统性能与自适应性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: RAID算法选择优化可提升存储性能与可靠性，对服务器和数据中心用户有直接价值。

items.title: GCC Patch Adjusting AMD Zen 5 Misprediction Cost Nets 12% Win In Benchmark
items.summary: An AMD compiler engineer posted a patch on Saturday for the GNU Compiler Collection (GCC). The two-line patch adjusts the misprediction cost for Zen 4 and Zen 5 processors, which ends up yielding a 12% improvement in one SPEC CPU benchmark on Zen 5 and a 9% improvement on Zen 4...
items.title_zh: GCC补丁调整AMD Zen 5分支预测错误代价，基准测试性能提升12%
items.summary_zh: AMD编译器工程师提交了一个仅两行的GCC补丁，调整Zen 4和Zen 5处理器的分支预测错误代价。补丁在SPEC CPU基准测试中为Zen 5带来12%性能提升，为Zen 4带来9%提升。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 小幅编译器调优即可显著提升实际性能，说明Zen架构分支预测机制仍有可挖掘的优化空间。

items.title: Linux 7.3 Introduces New AES Encryption APIs - Will Open Up More Performance
items.summary: Eric Biggers of Google continues carrying out great work on the Linux kernel crypto code. For Linux 7.3 he's landed work on new library APIs for most of the AES encryption modes used within the kernel. Moving forward this will open the door to more performance optimizations, reducing code duplication, and other enhancements...
items.title_zh: Linux 7.3引入全新AES加密API，为进一步性能优化铺路
items.summary_zh: Google工程师Eric Biggers持续改进Linux内核加密代码。在Linux 7.3中，他为内核中使用的大多数AES加密模式引入了新的库API，未来将开启更多性能优化空间，减少代码重复。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 新AES库API为内核加密性能优化与架构加速器支持铺平道路，同时降低重复代码、提升可维护性。

items.title: Lantronix Open-M 720G/520G – Ultra-compact LGA system-on-modules based on MediaTek Genio 720 and Genio 520 SoCs
items.summary: Lantronix Open-M 720G and 520G are compact (43x44mm) LGA system-on-modules (SoM) powered by 6nm MediaTek Genio 720 and Genio 520 SoCs, offering an AI performance of 10 TOPS, and designed for Edge IoT applications running low-power Vision AI and GenAI tasks. The Genio 720 dual-camera module ships with 8GB LPDDR5 and the Genio 520 single-camera module with 4GB LPDDR5. Both offer 128GB UFS storage, Gigabit Ethernet, optional WiFi 6 and Bluetooth 5.3 connectivity, dual display support, audio inputs/outputs, USB 3.2/2.0 interfaces, PCIe Gen2 x1, and more. items.title: $299 Arduino Ventuno Q SBC combines Qualcomm Dragonwing IQ8 SoC and STM32H5 MCU
items.summary: The Arduino Ventuno Q is a single board computer pairing a Qualcomm Dragonwing IQ8 (IQ-8275) octa-core Edge AI SoC with an STM32H5F5 Arm Cortex-M33 microcontroller for real-time I/Os. First introduced at Embedded World 2026, the Ventuno Q is the second Qualcomm-based Arduino board after the Arduino UNO Q launched in October 2025. It’s quite a different beast with a larger design featuring 16GB LPDDR5, 64GB eMMC flash, an M.2 socket for NVMe storage, 2.5GbE and Wi-Fi 6 networking, a 4K-capable HDMI output, and two USB 3.2 ports, while still offloading real-time I/O to a Cortex-M33 microcontroller. Arduino Ventuno Q (ABX00181) specifications: SoC – Qualcomm Dragonwing IQ8 (IQ-8275, also known as QCS8275): CPU – Octa-core Kryo Gen 6 (Arm Cortex-A78/A55) processor GPU – Adreno A623 AI accelerator -Hexagon Tensor AI Processor (NPU) up to 40 dense TOPS ISP – Qualcomm Spectra 692/690 ISP Microcontroller (MCU) – STMicro STM32H5F5 CPU core [...] The post $299 Arduino Ventuno Q SBC combines Qualcomm Dragonwing IQ8 SoC and STM32H5 MCU appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .
items.title_zh: 299美元Arduino Ventuno Q单板计算机：集成Qualcomm Dragonwing IQ8与STM32H5
items.summary_zh: Arduino Ventuno Q单板计算机（299美元）集成Qualcomm Dragonwing IQ8（IQ-8275）八核Edge AI SoC（最高40 TOPS NPU）与STM32H5F5 Arm Cortex-M33微控制器，配备16GB LPDDR5、64GB eMMC、M.2 NVMe、2.5GbE、Wi-Fi 6、4K HDMI与双USB 3.2接口，是继UNO Q之后第二款Qualcomm平台Arduino板，于Embedded World 2026首次亮相。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 首款集成Qualcomm Edge AI平台与STM32实时MCU的Arduino板卡，为边缘AI与实时控制融合应用提供高性价比硬件。
